**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause is `dep-4471`, the gateway config "connection-per-request for pool isolation". It shipped `02:12`–`02:14`. First 503 lands 18 seconds later. Pool churn hit `4180` opens per 5m against a baseline of `40`.

Impact runs `02:14:18Z` to `03:59:27Z`, still firing at log end. `530` 503s. On-call was paged 67 minutes late.

Roll back `dep-4471`. The worker slowdown is filed as a separate issue.
